title: Muraja'ah: An-Nazi'at 1 to 40: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 33. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ (٢٥) إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ (٢٦) ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا (٢٧) رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا (٢٨) وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا (٢٩) وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ (٣٠) أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا (٣١) وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا (٣٢) مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ (٣٣) فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (٣٤)

keywords.def: the order of sections and themes in a surah

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of 79:25-40 in register order.
questions.a: 79:25-40 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:25-40 and one older surah to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest ayat, then log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your own target from today's feedback in the portal response box. Start: 'Next time I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Next time I will hold the madd lazim in ٱلطَّآمَّةُ for six counts.'

questions.q: Which section comes after the story of Musa and Pharaoh?
questions.a: A) The signs of creation (79:27 to 33). 79:27 follows straight after the Pharaoh section ends at 79:26.

questions.q: Recite An-Nazi'at 79:38 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: An-Nazi'at has a clear structure: oaths, the Day, Musa and Pharaoh, creation, the two outcomes. How can knowing the structure help hifdh?
questions.a: Each section has a theme, so if you lose a word you can recall what comes next by meaning.
